rationale.conceptual: The method is a standard mean-field theory (Bragg-Williams approximation) with all equations and interaction energies explicitly given in the paper. Implementation requires translating algebraic expressions into code and performing a bounded numerical minimization, but no novel algorithm or deep domain insight is needed.
rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of a few sequential steps (implement model, compute two alloys) using only standard libraries (numpy, scipy). I/O is straightforward CSV output. No external data fetching or complex tool orchestration.

difficulty.reasoning: The task reproduces a Bragg-Williams free energy model for CuMnPt6 and MnPt7 using explicit formulas and parameters from the paper, requiring only numerical minimization of a known analytical function. The method is a textbook statistical thermodynamics calculation, and the pipeline is a single script generating two CSVs. No large data, no GPUs needed.
